job.title: Network Solutions Architect
job.description:
Network Solutions Architect / Senior Network Engineer


My client is looking for a highly experienced Network Solutions Architect / Senior Network Engineer who combines deep technical knowledge with the ability to sit in front of customers and make complex technology understandable.

You may be an experienced senior engineer, solutions architect or technical consultant who has spent many years designing networks, completing feasibility work and understanding how complex technology environments fit together.

You don't need to be a salesperson.

In fact, the credibility that comes from being an experienced technical professional who genuinely understands the customer's environment is exactly what we're looking for.

Key Responsibilities
  • Work directly with corporate and enterprise customers to understand their environments.
  • Undertake technical discovery and feasibility assessments.
  • Design network and connectivity solutions.
  • Understand how complex network, security and infrastructure components fit together.
  • Work alongside BDMs and Account Managers during customer engagements.
  • Develop technically robust solutions appropriate to customer requirements.
  • Explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Assist customers who may not fully understand their existing network environment.
  • Support solution development, proposals and technical presentations.
  • Provide technical credibility during major customer opportunities.

  • My clients customers often rely heavily on its engineers to help them understand how complex solutions should be constructed, making this role an important part of both customer delivery and the commercial process.

Technical Background Ideally you'll have significant experience across:

  • Enterprise network architecture and design.
  • LAN/WAN and enterprise connectivity.
  • Network security and associated infrastructure.
  • Solution architecture.
  • Technical feasibility and solution design.
  • Complex enterprise environments.
  • Customer-facing technical consulting.
Cisco CCNP/CCIE-level capability or equivalent would be highly regarded.

What Will Make You Stand Out Technical capability alone isn't enough.

We're looking for someone who can take something complicated and make it simple for the customer.

You'll be technically confident without needing to prove you're the smartest person in the room. You'll be able to explain solutions respectfully and clearly without making customers — or other engineers — feel uncomfortable or out of their depth.

My client operates a high-trust, adult environment. People aren't micromanaged; employees are trusted to manage their responsibilities and personal commitments. The business has a flat structure, values kindness and respect, doesn't tolerate blame culture, and expects people to ask for help when they need it. Leadership is described as compassionate and trusting, and employees are supported rather than "thrown under the bus."

Just as importantly, reputation matters. My client is careful about what it takes to market and wants employees who care about their own professional reputation as much as the company cares about its brand.

Please note ALL CV's are reviewed by humans, although we embrace technology be believe AI does not replace senior experienced recruiters!

Due to the urgency we will not accept overseas applications unless to are arriving in the very near future.

job.title: Strategic Account Manager
job.description:
Strategic Account Manager 


My client has developed an outstanding base of valued customers and is looking for an experienced Strategic Account Manager to ensure those relationships continue to receive exceptional service.

This is much more than a traditional Account Manager position.

You'll become the person customers know they can rely on — ensuring questions are answered, commitments are followed through and nothing disappears into a "black hole."

You'll work alongside the Head of Service Delivery, IT Network engineers, business development and leadership teams to maintain, protect and grow existing customer relationships.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own and develop relationships across an established customer portfolio.
  • Become a trusted point of contact for customers.
  • Ensure customer requests, questions and commitments are followed through.
  • Proactively communicate progress even when a final answer isn't yet available.
  • Coordinate internal technical and service-delivery resources.
  • Understand customer requirements and changing business priorities.
  • Manage contract renewals, variations and commercial conversations.
  • Support proposals, contracts and other customer documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to expand Feenix's services within existing customers.
  • Work alongside technical specialists to identify additional customer solutions.
  • Protect customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Maintain disciplined account plans and follow-up processes.
What We're Looking For You'll bring:

  • At least five years' relevant account management experience.
  • A high-level technical understanding of IT networks and associated services
  • Experience managing important corporate/enterprise level customers.
  • Exceptional follow-through and attention to detail.
  • Strong organisational and planning capability.
  • Commercial and negotiation skills.
  • Confidence dealing with different personalities and stakeholders.
  • The ability to remain structured while working under pressure.
  • A proactive approach to customer service.
  • Technology or telecommunications experience would be a significant advantage.
Detailed technical expertise isn't essential because you'll have access to engineering capability. What matters most is your ability to serve customers exceptionally well, keep your commitments and build trust.

Farmer AND Hunter While protecting existing relationships is fundamental, this isn't purely a maintenance role.

You'll be expected to understand your customers well enough to recognise opportunities.

The successful person therefore needs to be predominantly a farmer, but with enough hunter instinct to identify and develop additional business within their accounts.

job.description:
Senior Business Development Manager – Government & Enterprise 

The Role This is a senior strategic growth role responsible for establishing and growing my clients presence across the Wellington government and enterprise market.

We are looking for someone exceptionally well connected who can open doors at senior levels and introduce my clients capability into organisations where relationships, reputation and credibility matter.

You will effectively own the Wellington government and enterprise market.

Key Responsibilities
  • Establish and grow my clients presence within Wellington.
  • Leverage your existing network to secure senior-level customer conversations.
  • Identify significant network, connectivity, security and technology opportunities.
  • Develop strategic account-entry plans for targeted organisations.
  • Understand customer business and technology challenges.
  • Work alongside technical specialists to develop solutions.
  • Develop and manage complex, long-term sales opportunities.
  • Build a sustainable pipeline of government and enterprise business.
  • Become a recognised and trusted representative of my client in the Wellington market.
What We're Looking For You will likely have:

  • Extensive senior business development/account experience within NZ technology or telecommunications.
  • A strong and active Wellington network, particularly across government and enterprise.
  • Existing relationships that enable you to gain senior-level appointments.
  • Experience with a recognised technology, telecommunications or cloud organisation would be highly regarded.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise technology environments.
  • Experience selling complex technology/network solutions.
  • Demonstrated success navigating long and complex procurement cycles.
  • Excellent commercial and negotiation capability.
  • Strong personal credibility and reputation within the market.
Candidates coming from organisations such as major telcos, cloud providers or large technology vendors may be particularly relevant because an established network and recognised background can help open doors.

Support You won't be expected to be the technical expert on every solution.

My client has technical capability in Wellington, including a Network Solutions Architect/engineering resource, allowing you to bring technical expertise into customer conversations when required.

The Person This role requires someone comfortable operating autonomously.

You'll have the confidence to build a market without needing a large corporate infrastructure around you, while having the maturity to bring other people into an opportunity when their expertise is required.

Your network, reputation and integrity will be fundamental to your success.

job.title: Senior Programme Scheduler
job.description:
Programme Scheduler

Resource & Capacity Planning Lead – Digital & Data 6-month contract | Auckland | September start

We’re looking for an experienced Programme Scheduler to establish and embed a strong capacity planning practice across a large Digital & Data portfolio within an established business unit, with competing deliverables.  This is not a Project Manager role.  This is a people-focused resource and capacity planning role. It’s about understanding the capability, capacity and skills across the portfolio, matching the right people to the right work, and helping teams get the best from their resources.

The role 
You’ll work closely with Project Managers and Digital & Data leaders to establish and embed a consistent resource and capacity planning practice by:

  • Understanding the skills, capability and availability of people across the portfolio
  • Matching resource capability to current and future project demand
  • Helping ensure people are being used effectively and sustainably
  • Identifying capacity gaps, bottlenecks and over-allocation early
  • Working with PMs to understand and challenge future resource requirements
  • Balancing competing priorities across multiple projects and programmes
  • Building a clear forward view of demand versus capacity
  • Establishing practical processes, governance and reporting
  • Supporting effective use of Float for resource and capacity planning
What we’re looking for:
You’ll have demonstrated experience where resource and capacity planning has been a core part of your role - across a technology, digital or transformation portfolio.
You will have been a Programme Coordinator / Resource Capacity planner / Senior Programme Scheduler.

You’ll bring:
  • Strong portfolio-level resource and capacity planning experience
  • Experience translating delivery plans and roadmaps into resource demand
  • Ability to assess demand against available people, skills and capacity
  • Strong forecasting and resource allocation capability
  • Experience establishing or improving resource management processes
  • Confidence challenging senior Project Managers and stakeholders
  • Strong governance, reporting and analytical skills
  • Experience with resource planning or PPM tools (Float experience would be advantageous)
This role will suit someone who can bring structure, discipline and forward visibility to a complex delivery environment.

Apply now, if you are available immediately in Auckland, and have the expertise and relevant experience we are looking for.

job.title: Technical Sales Manager
job.description:
Technical Sales Manager – IT & T

Senior BDM | Strong existing network | Flexible working | Uncapped earning potential

An excellent opportunity has opened with a highly successful, home-grown New Zealand IT and telecommunications business with an established reputation, strong customer base and ambitious plans for continued growth.
We’re looking for an experienced Technical Sales Manager / Senior Business Development Manager who understands technology, knows how to build trusted relationships and has an established network across New Zealand's mid-market and enterprise sectors.

The Opportunity

This is a genuine business development role for someone who enjoys opening doors, developing relationships and translating technology into clear commercial benefits for customers.
You’ll work with clients to understand their business and technology challenges and demonstrate how smarter connectivity and security solutions can deliver:
  • Improved network performance and uptime
  • Stronger security and resilience
  • Faster, more reliable connectivity
  • Reduced complexity and administration
  • Better productivity and time savings
  • Simpler, more effective technology environments
What We're Looking For

You’ll be a senior, experienced BDM or Technical Sales professional with:
  • A strong network of established business relationships
  • Proven success developing and winning new business
  • Experience selling into mid-sized and enterprise organisations
  • A solid understanding of business internet, networks, connectivity, security and firewalls
  • The ability to explain technical solutions in terms of real business benefits and ROI
  • Strong relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills
  • A proactive, commercially driven approach
You don't need to be a network engineer, but you do need to understand the technology well enough to confidently engage with senior business and technology decision-makers.

What's On Offer?
  • Excellent remuneration package
  • Uncapped bonus potential for strong performers
  • Flexible working – predominantly work from home
  • Only one compulsory office day per week
  • Established NZ business with a strong reputation and customer base
  • The autonomy to build and develop your market
  • An opportunity where strong performance will be genuinely rewarded
If you're an experienced technology sales professional with a strong network and enjoy turning technical capability into compelling business outcomes, we'd like to hear from you.

  • Strong SQL skills with the ability to write and analyse queries independently
  • Experience working with databases, data analysis, and reporting requirements
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills

If you are a Business Analyst who enjoys combining stakeholder engagement with hands-on data analysis and SQL, we'd love to hear from you.
